hero.title: Join the Night Sky Guides
hero.intro: For trained guides who want to share the night sky of Kerry with visitors from all over the world.

benefits: Your own profile on the Night Sky Guides Ireland website
A pin on our guide map so visitors can find you
Exchange and further training with other guides
News, sky events and resources for your tours

box.title: Membership details
box.text: We are finalising our membership details. Interested? Send us a short message and we'll get back to you as soon as they are ready.
